classifier.name: baseline_b0
notes: api/routes/analyze.py points at best_classifier_finetuned.weights.h5, which does not exist; this is the only trained classifier on disk.
The logit encodes P(real) (Keras label 1 = 'real'); analyze.py reads it as P(AI), which inverts every production verdict. This adapter reports 1 - sigmoid(logit).
seen_paths reconstructs the Keras 80/20 seed-42 split from today's directory listing.
